OPEC Cuts Down Tanker Demand
10 Feb 2017: It appears that the whole world (at least the people that are interested in oil supply and energy prices) is watching OPEC output to see if the member countries are adhering to the crude oil production and export cuts that they promised in meetings in September and November 2016.
